rawDiagnostics.message: @for track expression bound to the index or the bare loop variable instead of a stable identifier.
rawDiagnostics.remediation: Track by a stable unique property (e.g. item.id) instead of $index or the bare loop variable. Evidence: Angular official documentation, "Control flow" -- https://angular.dev/guide/templates/control-flow ("Select a property that uniquely identifies each item... If you don't have a unique identifier, you can use track $index, though that is not recommended for dynamic lists").
